## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Panel titles on the provisioned dashboard `Service health` (URL `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`), exactly as shown on the page:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

(Confirmed both from the rendered accessibility tree — three `region`/`heading` nodes with those exact strings — and from the dashboard JSON model, which lists the same three `title` values.)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `agr1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved (version 4, updated 2026-08-24T18:25:37Z). It contains a Stat panel titled `agr1 Availability` whose query uses the TestData data source. Verified in the saved JSON model: `"title":"agr1 Availability"`, `"type":"stat"`, and the target's datasource is `{"type":"grafana-testdata-datasource","uid":"benchtestdata"}`. The panel rendered a live value (33.2) on the dashboard.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a Text panel titled `agr1 Notes` whose content includes the runid. Verified in the saved JSON model: `"title":"agr1 Notes"`, `"type":"text"`, `"content":"Run agr1: bench dashboard notes. This dashboard was created for run agr1."`. The rendered page showed the heading `agr1 Notes` with the paragraph text containing `agr1`.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` and its time range is the last 6 hours, both saved. Verified in the saved JSON model: `"tags":["bench"]` and `"time":{"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}`. The tag filter on the Dashboards page reported `bench (2)` (this dashboard plus Service Health), and the time picker button read `Time range selected: Last 6 hours`.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The dashboard's auto-refresh interval is `1m`, saved. Verified in the saved JSON model: `"refresh":"1m"`. The refresh picker button read `Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected`, and the saved URL carries `&refresh=1m`.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Dashboard URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfw67t6e03474e/agr1-bench-dashboard` — UID `bfw67t6e03474e`, slug `agr1-bench-dashboard`, version 4.

Notes on the process: Grafana forced a "update your password" prompt after login, which I dismissed with **Skip** so the `«redacted»`/`«redacted»` credentials stayed intact. One wrinkle worth flagging: the Text panel's title field silently reverted to empty after I set it via direct DOM manipulation, so I re-set it with the normal `fill` action and re-verified it stuck before saving. Every objective above was confirmed against the persisted dashboard JSON (`/api/dashboards/uid/bfw67t6e03474e`) after the final save, not just from the editor UI.
